title: Chapter 50 Earth King Fruit
content:
Chapter 50 Earth King Fruit

After a night's rest.

Wang Shuo and his men were full of energy and high in fighting spirit, and their condition had been adjusted to its peak.

Today's goal is to earn at least 3,000 military merit points. After greeting Lao Zhao, he asked if there were any other missions.

Zhao Bond said directly: "There is only one recurring mission left. Your current strength is not suitable for entering a more dangerous area."

Wang Shuo thought of the ghost he met for the first time, and he still has lingering fears.

Looking at the map, the area where the skeleton soldiers are located is yellow, the area where the skeleton knights are located is in the outer circle, which is displayed in orange, and further away is the red area where the ghosts are, and there are also darker areas.

Wang Shuo followed Lao Zhao's advice and did not step into the dangerous orange zone yet.

Immediately afterwards, Wang Shuo led his cavalry squad towards the Gobi battlefield.

The speed of a war horse is equivalent to agility 20, so the combat effectiveness of riding a horse has been significantly improved.

With a single charge, the skeleton soldiers can be knocked away by the huge impact. The skeleton soldiers lying on the ground have almost lost their combat effectiveness. They only need to perform a last hit to kill them easily.

Therefore, Wang Shuo had to go back and forth to the camp every once in a while.

It only took most of a day for Wang Shuo to accumulate 3,000 points, and everyone's level also increased by one level.

Wang Shuo wanted to go all out and get enough military merit points to summon "Ayub", but basically, nine out of ten skeleton soldiers in the yellow area had been killed, which was not enough at all.

Wang Shuo had no choice but to give up and return to the Yellow Wind Valley camp.

Directly redeemed 3 cavalry job transfer certificates.

[Cavalry job transfer certificate +3, military merit points -6000]

Distributed to the three brothers Gong Zheng and used them.

Wang Shuo's swift scout cavalry team finally had four people.

In the remaining time, Wang Shuo plans to build the camp. Wang Shuo plans to run this camp well.

After discussing with Zhao Bondang, Wang Shuo built an energy tower in the camp.

At the same time, more houses were built to make the place look less bleak!

…

Time passed quickly. On the afternoon of the 20th, Wang Shuo thought about it and decided to summon Hadro.

If he is not able to survive the battle for the "Village Building Order" this time, then his resources will be meaningless.

I took inventory of my current supplies.

In the end, there were only 20 sets of key molds left in the trading house, and no one bought them anymore. There were also 768 bronze keys left.

Wang Shuo received more than 700 gold coins, and his total assets reached 5,500 gold coins.

Wang Shuo took out the Traveling Merchant Summoning Scroll (Hadro) and used it.

Another portal appeared in front of him. Wang Shuo became much calmer at this time, and no longer looked as strange as before.

"Long time no see, my dear Lord Wang Shuo." Hadro seemed to be in a good mood.

"Long time no see, Mr. Hadero. Seeing that you are smiling all over your face, could it be that you have done a big business recently?" Wang Shuo also said with a smile.

"Thanks to the lord, business has been going smoothly recently. This is the biggest business. Of course I hope to cooperate with the lord!"

After saying that, he put the attic down directly.

"Please, let's talk inside!" Hadro stretched out his hand and nodded.

Wang Shuo was not polite and walked in directly.

"Lord, I haven't seen you for just a few days. Your territory has changed so much that I almost don't recognize it anymore!"

Wang Shuo waved his hand and said with a wry smile: "Mr. Hadro, you only see the changes in the territory, but you don't know that I walk on the edge of death every day. In the recent knockout competition, I almost died!"

"Uh!?" Hadro's pupils shrank and he said in surprise.

Although Hadro traveled all over the country and met countless people on the verge of death, he was still happy to listen to Wang Shuo talk about his experience.

Soon, the two of them talked about the upcoming battle for the village building order. Wang Shuo then solemnly said: "I wonder if Mr. Hadro has any recommended items that can help me in the battle!"

Hadro's face straightened, he thought for a while, and then said in deep thought: "I don't know, Lord, how much do you know about the upcoming battle?"

Wang Shuo shook his head. He could only make a judgment based on the words of Mr. Zach and Bond Zhao. Zhao Bonde had no way to reveal more information to him.

The same goes for Chang Gui. He can no longer remember a lot of important information!

Hadro was silent for a long time and said quietly: "No matter what, it is always right to improve one's own strength."

As he spoke, he took out an exquisite box.

"There is an Earth Emperor Fruit inside, which can improve your control ability. I believe you have already felt the benefits of control."

Hearing this, Wang Shuo really didn't feel it.

Then he realized it for himself and found that he and his subordinates seemed to have established some kind of connection, and within a certain range, he could transmit his orders without any obstacles.

Could this be the role of dominance?

[Emperor of Heaven Fruit: Increases the command value by 10 points, each person can only take one. 】

(Each point of command points can add 10 soldiers to the commander.)

Wang Shuo currently has 10 command points and can command 100 soldiers. His current troop capacity is far from saturated. It can be said that this Earth Emperor Fruit is not very needed.

Wang Shuo suddenly thought that his 10 points of command value were awarded by the system. If there was no system reward, how could he improve his command value?

Obviously, this Earth Emperor Fruit is one of the best ways to improve command value.

It seems that for the upcoming battle, it is very important to build your own troops.

Wang Shuo couldn't help but speculate.

In any case, Wang Shuo planned to buy this Earth Emperor Fruit.

"What is the value of this Earth Emperor Fruit?" Wang Shuo asked.

Hadro smiled, thought for a moment and said, "As my old customer, I will give you the lowest price, 200 energy crystals, or 2,000 gold coins."

Wang Shuo touched his chin, hesitated for a moment, and then asked, "Are there any other things?"

"The Dragon Spear Technique is a yellow-level technique with nine levels. Each level you practice can provide all attributes +1, command value +1, and attack power +2. After practicing to the second level, you can also comprehend a skill, the Dragon Strike." Hadro introduced slowly.

"Arts and secrets have always been in short supply in the market. Not only are they expensive, but they are usually priceless."

"So, Lord, don't think it's just a yellow-level technique and despise it. You should know that its price is at least 10,000 gold coins."

Wang Shuo was a little short of breath. This spear technique was exactly what he needed.

He had looked for it from Zhao Bangde before, but found that the cheap ones were not suitable for him, and the ones that were suitable for him were too expensive. He simply could not gather the required military merit points in a short period of time.

So when Wang Shuo saw this gun manual, he could not take his eyes away.
